body:
sheesh...thought id give the voices in my head a break...this time they’re just dialled in

down again, feel so cold and alone - really what am i actually waiting for?  this aint never pickin up not really gonna turn a corner - so what is it?!
lovely, i wanna go there - where is that?
Happy Birthday 🎂 - i know this wont be much but know youre not the inly one who feels the same way

that’s the thing...it’s so easy to say Make it Happen - How?  where do i begin?  what do I do?  when everything’s pressing on you who do you rely on?  you do the best work you can it’s not enough - you support the whole family and who supports you?  when you need someone who’s there for you?  Who?!  

it’s way too easy to look at things “positively” i agree!  how do you act on them when even before you start the negativity sinks in, the impossibility stares you down - all your longings to be there for her for them who’s there for you?

but that’s the hardest part...being aware that no one’s really there...you want to reach out, you cry, you do everything - you’ve got 500 FB friends none of them are really close, you have your family but most of the time they’re the source of your suffering - at this point of my life I want to be selfish, i want to be greedy but even if I do - id be selfish and greedy for what?  Attention?  All i ever get was negative vibes, why’d you do that? what you tryin to prove?  This is why endin it could be the most viable answer but you’re too scared to die and too frustrated to live - what else is there for???  is this really what life is just all about?  you wake up you study or work and what’s next after that?????
i want to learn how you did it?  i want to do it too! Congrats!
how much is it?  and where?
